title: Some of TV’s Top Stars Have Yet to Win an Emmy
summary: As Emmy voters prepare to make a final decision on who should win each category, IndieWire highlights several nominated actors who have made TV history, but have so far left empty-handed.

title: ‘One Night Only’ Review: Fascism Gets Off Easy in This Flirty Humiliation Ritual for Will Gluck Fans
summary: Monica Barbaro still shines opposite a lackluster Callum Turner in this woefully misguided rom-com.

title: ‘Sterling Point’ Review: Megan Park’s Teen Drama Is a Delightful Summer Escape — and Honest Where It Counts
summary: The writer and director behind "My Old Ass" sticks close to home for her first TV series, about a 17-year-old New Yorker who inherits an island in Canada — where her secret sister awaits.

title: ‘Super Troopers 3’ Review: A Cult Comedy Franchise Takes a Mustache Ride Toward Mediocrity
summary: Driven by little more than heavy-handed comedy about cultural differences between American and Indian families, this threequel is for the diehard fans only.

title: The 2026 Student Academy Awards Are Coming to the Toronto International Film Festival
summary: The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences has announced the winners of the 53rd Student Academy Awards, with gold, silver and bronze placements in the four award categories to be announced at TIFF.

title: Indie Film’s Next Money Doesn’t Want Your Passion Project
summary: Hollywood studios might be scouring for the next "Obsession," but there's a growing class of investors looking for projects that match their values.

title: ‘The Shards’ Review: Ryan Murphy’s Unboring Bret Easton Ellis Adaptation Never Comes Together
summary: Set in 1980s Beverly Hills, the first season of FX's new drama series follows a quartet of rich teens whose idyllic adolescence is upended by the arrival of a mysterious "boy" — and a serial killer.

title: NYFF Reveals Main Slate: Sandra Hüller in ‘Rose,’ Andrew Haigh’s ‘A Long Winter,’ Mike Leigh’s ‘Tender Loving Care,’ and Cannes Favorites
summary: The New York Film Festival has named the full list of 32 films — from 31 countries — that comprise its Main Slate. Previously announced were the latest from James Gray, Ava DuVernay, and Tony Gilroy.

title: TIFF Launches Docs Like Alex Gibney’s ‘Musk,’ Barbara Kopple’s ‘Union Town,’ and Megan Rapinoe Opener
summary: Programmer Thom Powers walks IndieWire through the documentaries on view at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival.

title: ‘What Waits Beyond the Edge of the Known World?’: Laika’s ‘Wildwood’ Poster Teases  Portland-Set Stop-Motion Adventure
summary: Director Travis Knight shares an exclusive statement about the visual metaphors found in the first poster for his film, which opens this October.

title: ‘Ted Lasso’ Season 4 Review: Jason Sudeikis’ Cheery Coach Is Still Off His Game
summary: After three years off the air, Apple's feel-good hit returns to see how Coach Lasso's belief system fares with a women's soccer club — and if the wayward comedy can recover from a catastrophic third season.

title: Juliette Lewis Recalls Robert De Niro on Set of Scorsese’s ‘Cape Fear’: ‘He Had an Organ Player and Was Speaking in Tongues’
summary: Lewis looks back with IndieWire on her Oscar-nominated role in Martin Scorsese's 1991 thriller — and ponders what could be next for her role on the series.
